## Purpose

Describe the problem or capability this change addresses.

## Change class

- [ ] Editorial
- [ ] Additive
- [ ] Structural
- [ ] Canonical

## Evidence and provenance

List material sources, evidence, assumptions, or decision records supporting the change.

## Governance check

- [ ] The change preserves explicit human authority for canonical approval.
- [ ] Structural implications have been identified.
- [ ] Machine-readable artefacts remain aligned with human-readable meaning.
- [ ] No planned governance migration is represented as already canonical.

## Validation

Describe checks performed and expected behaviour.

## Follow-up

Record unresolved questions, later maturity work, or intentionally deferred changes.
